description: This file defines the 'Review' model class for the OpenCart admin catalog module. It provides methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve product reviews from the database, including managing ratings and review status.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: The class manages product reviews within the OpenCart admin catalog system, providing CRUD operations and review analytics.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Creates a new review record in the database and updates the product rating.

methods.name: editReview
methods.description: Updates an existing review record and recalculates the product rating.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Changes the approval status of a review.

methods.name: deleteReview
methods.description: Deletes a review and updates the product rating accordingly.

methods.name: deleteReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Deletes all reviews associated with a specific product ID.

methods.name: getReview
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific review.

methods.name: getRating
methods.description: Calculates the average rating for a product based on approved reviews.

methods.name: getReviews
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews based on provided filtering criteria.

methods.name: getTotalReviews
methods.description: Counts total reviews matching specific filters.

methods.name: getTotalReviewsAwaitingApproval
methods.description: Counts the number of reviews pending approval.
